system.description:
Favoured weapon: Hammer, Light

Granted power: Advantage on Craft and Smith checks. Once/day: repair a broken weapon or armour to full functionality instantly. Your Divine Mount wears god-forged barding: +2 AC, and its hits deal +1d6 fire damage.

Allegiance: True Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Brigh in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: protect one inventor, workshop or idea from those who'd destroy it (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
